_about: The design review of a map (src/map_review/, tools/map.gd -- check). Every number the review measures against, and every line it says. A line's {words} are filled in from the finding. level: MUST FIX (the map is broken), SHOULD (it plays worse than it could), NICE (an idea). what: the plain line (what is wrong and where), fix: how to fix it, say: the same in the game's own voice.

validate_error.say: THE COUNTY CLERK WON'T SIGN THIS ONE OFF YET.

validate_warning.say: IT'LL STAND UP, BUT IT'S LEANIN'.

route_failed.what: A player walking from {from} to {to} could not get there: stopped {short} cells short at {end}{stuck}.
route_failed.fix: Look at the plan picture near {end}: a step too high (over .245), a doorway too narrow or low, stairs whose foot is blocked, or a gap with no deck. map render {map} overlay=nav,unreachable shows where the walk ends.
route_failed.say: I WALKED TILL MY BOOTS GAVE OUT AND NEVER GOT TO {TO}.

unreached.what: Nobody can get to {what} {name} at {at}: there is no way there from the start, even with every door open.
unreached.fix: Join its floor to the rest: stairs, a ramp or a ladder up to z {z}, or a doorway into the room it is in; or move it to where the start can walk (map render {map} overlay=nav,unreachable).
unreached.say: NOBODY CAN GET TO THE {NAME}: NO STAIRS, NO LADDER, NO NOTHIN'.

out_of_order.what: {what} {name} at {at} can only be reached through {through}, which stays shut until it is done: the map cannot be finished.
out_of_order.fix: Put {name} where it can be reached before {through} opens, or let something earlier open {through} (a station's opens, or another key).
out_of_order.say: THE KEY'S LOCKED IN THE ROOM IT OPENS. THAT'S A COUNTY CLASSIC.

ammo_short.what: The {hands} hands at {at} take about {need} {rounds} to put down, and the way there gives about {have}.
ammo_short.fix: Lay {rounds} (or food) along the way before them, within a few cells of the path, or thin the bunch out.
ammo_short.say: THE {HANDS} BOYS UP AHEAD NEED ABOUT {NEED} {ROUNDS} AND THE WAY THERE GIVES {HAVE}.

no_cover.what: The walk into the fight at {at} is open for {steps} steps in the hands' sight: nothing to duck behind (no wall, crate, truck or post within {reach} cells).
no_cover.fix: Put cover along the last stretch before {at}: a cover object (crates, a low wall), a parked truck or a fence end every 6 to 8 cells.
no_cover.say: WIDE OPEN FOR {STEPS} STEPS. NOTHIN' TO HIDE BEHIND BUT YOUR OWN SHADOW.

spawn_seen.what: A hand ({name}) at {at} can see the start from {far} cells away: the player is shot before they can move.
spawn_seen.fix: Move {name} out of the start's sight, or stand a wall, a building or a hedge between them.
spawn_seen.say: A {KIND} CAN SEE THE START. YOU'LL GET SHOT BEFORE YOU FINISH YAWNIN'.

alley.what: There is a long open look of {far} cells from {at} toward {to}: a shooting alley.
alley.fix: If it is not meant as a sniper's lane, break it with a building, a truck or a hedge part way along.
alley.say: YOU CAN SEE CLEAR TO THE NEXT COUNTY FROM HERE.

dead_end.what: The way past {at} is a dead end {deep} steps deep with nothing in it.
dead_end.fix: Put something worth the walk at its end (rounds, food, a stash or a sign), or open it through to somewhere else so it is a loop.
dead_end.say: THAT'S A DEAD END WITH NOTHIN' IN IT. NOT EVEN A POSSUM.

no_secrets.what: The map has no secrets: no secret door and no stash off the way.
no_secrets.fix: Hide a stash: a door with secret true into a small room with rounds or food, or a pickup tucked {off} or more steps off the way.
no_secrets.say: NO SECRETS. HIDE A STASH SOMEWHERE A FELLA WOULDN'T LOOK.

quiet_stretch.what: The walk from {from} to {to} (going to {leg}) is {steps} steps with nothing on it: no hand within {hand} cells, no pickup within {loot}, no sign or station within {look}.
quiet_stretch.fix: Break it up with a hand or two, a pickup, a sign or a set piece part way along (about {mid}).
quiet_stretch.say: THE WALK FROM HERE TO THERE IS {STEPS} STEPS OF NOTHIN'. BRING A SANDWICH.

first_fight_late.what: The first hand is {steps} steps along the way from the start.
first_fight_late.fix: Put a hand or two nearer the start so the player gets a shot off early.
first_fight_late.say: FELLA COULD DIE OF OLD AGE BEFORE THE FIRST FIGHT.

flat.what: Everything is on the ground: nothing to climb.
flat.fix: Add height: a loft (balcony and stairs), a dock (block and ramp) or a ladder up onto a roof, ideally where a fight happens.
flat.say: FLAT AS A FLITTER. GIVE A FELLA SOMETHIN' TO CLIMB.

no_districts.what: {count} places have no name: the player sees nothing when they walk in.
no_districts.fix: Give the map districts with names (districts: [{"id", "name"}]) and set district on the objects in each.
no_districts.say: NOBODY KNOWS WHAT TO CALL THIS PLACE. NOT EVEN THE MAILMAN.

empty_ground.what: {share} of the open ground has nothing near it (within {reach} cells): bare yard.
empty_ground.fix: Dress the emptiest yards by hand: a few things that belong together against a wall (a truck and its tyres, a woodpile), a sign, a pickup. Never scatter things just to fill.
empty_ground.say: A LOT OF NOTHIN' OUT THERE. EVEN THE WEEDS ARE BORED.

dark_room.what: The roofed place {name} around {at} is very dark (light {light}).
dark_room.fix: Hang a lamp in it (a light object over its cells, amount .15 to .25).
dark_room.say: DARKER'N THE INSIDE OF A COW IN THERE.

cost_should.what: {what} is {value}, over the {budget} a map should stay under.
cost_should.fix: Use fewer pieces: one long wall instead of many short ones, solid cells for buildings nobody climbs, fewer cut openings.
cost_should.say: THAT'S A LOT OF LUMBER FOR ONE MAP.

cost_most.what: {what} is {value}, over the most a map may have ({budget}).
cost_most.fix: Cut it down: merge walls, use solid cells for buildings nobody climbs, split the map in two.

arena_loot.what: As a deathmatch arena the map has {heals} things to heal with and {rounds} rounds lying out.
arena_loot.fix: Lay at least two of each (rinds or beer, and shells or bullets) down each lane, both sides alike.
arena_loot.say: A FELLA CAN'T FIGHT ON AN EMPTY STOMACH AND AN EMPTY GUN.

no_way.what: The map has no objective and no exit: it was checked as a versus arena.
no_way.fix: For a one-player map add a station (an objective) and an exit with shutdown naming it.
no_way.say: NO JOB TO DO AND NO ROAD OUT. MUST BE A FIGHTIN' PIT.

bot_stuck.what: The bot ({skill}) did not finish the map in {seconds} s of play ({outcome}); it ended at {at}.
bot_stuck.fix: Look at the bot's end place in the plan: a fight too hard to get past, a door it cannot open, or the objective pin leading it nowhere.
bot_stuck.say: THE BOY NEVER MADE IT HOME. SOMEBODY CALL HIS MAMA.

bot_deaths.what: The bot ({skill}) died {deaths} times at NORMAL before it finished.
bot_deaths.fix: Ease the worst fight: fewer hands at once, cover on the way in, food and rounds before it.
bot_deaths.say: DIED {DEATHS} TIMES. THAT AIN'T A MAP, THAT'S A FUNERAL.

bot_calm.what: The bot went {seconds} s without a fight (from about {from} s in).
bot_calm.fix: Put hands along that part of the way, or shorten it.
bot_calm.say: {SECONDS} SECONDS OF NOTHIN'. THE BOT TOOK A NAP.

bot_fight_share.what: The bot spent only {share} of its time fighting.
bot_fight_share.fix: More hands, nearer the way, or a shorter walk between fights.
bot_fight_share.say: MORE WALKIN' THAN A MAIL ROUTE.

bot_lost.what: The bot was lost {count} times ({seconds} s with the objective no nearer).
bot_lost.fix: Make the way read: a sign or an arrow at the turn, a light over the door, or fewer ways that look alike.
bot_lost.say: THE BOY GOT TURNED AROUND {COUNT} TIMES. PUT UP A SIGN.

pictures_skipped.fix: Run map check on a machine with a display (the plans from above are still in the folder).

verdicts.PASS: PASS: nothing to fix. The NICE items are ideas.
verdicts.WORK: WORK: it plays, but fix the SHOULD items.
verdicts.FAIL: FAIL: fix the MUST FIX items first.

says.PASS: THAT'LL DO. THAT'LL DO JUST FINE.
says.WORK: IT'S GOOD BONES. NEEDS A COAT OF PAINT.
